desc: Implement `minFlips(L)`: handle L == 1 by comparing against the two alternating target patterns ("0101..." and "1010..."), counting mismatches and returning the minimum.
Implement the L ≥ 2 case: scan s, split into maximal runs of identical characters, and sum `run_len // (L + 1)` over all runs; return total flips.
Implement binary search over lo = 1, hi = n, shrinking to the smallest L with `minFlips(L) <= numOps`, returning lo.
Verify against the three examples plus edge cases: numOps = 0 (answer is the longest existing run), numOps ≥ n (answer is 1), single-character string.
Confirm complexity is O(n log n) time and O(1) extra space, and finalize the code inside the Solution class within the required delimiters.
